cards.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Security Breach
cards.body: Malicious AI agents exploited exposed credentials and overly permissive cloud roles to infiltrate systems across India. The vulnerability stemmed from insecure app configurations and public code repositories left unprotected.

cards.title: Robotics Still in 'Lego Era,' Says Nvidia Vet
cards.body: Amulya Vishwanath, former Nvidia robotics product leader, argues robotics hasn't reached its ChatGPT moment yet. Basic building blocks like actuators, hands, and safety standards are still being rebuilt.

cards.title: Elorian's Glimpse Model Outperforms GPT-6 Astra
cards.body: Elorian launched Glimpse, an AI model that reasons with images rather than just analyzing them. The model beats even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and video captioning tasks.

cards.title: Vercel's Jev Becomes Fastest-Adopted AI Model
cards.body: Jev has become Vercel's fastest-adopted AI model ever, according to data from Vercel's AI gateway. The unified API service tracks adoption patterns across its AI model offerings.

cards.title: Mark Wahlberg Embraces AI in Filmmaking
cards.body: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg expressed openness to AI in film production when used responsibly. He's even willing to allow an AI clone to continue his legacy.

cards.title: Veritas Anti-Counterfeit Chip Expands Product Range
cards.body: Veritas expanded its anti-counterfeit verification chip beyond traditional goods to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance. The technology combats increasingly sophisticated "superfakes" flooding luxury markets.

cards.title: Replit CEO Envisions 'Self-Driving Companies'
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad describes a future where AI agents handle day-to-day operations autonomously. Humans would focus on higher-level strategic decisions in these self-driving companies.

cards.title: Cal AI Generated $30M Revenue Before Acquisition
cards.body: Cal AI leveraged a strategic influencer marketing campaign to achieve viral success and $30M in revenue. MyFitnessPal acquired the startup in March for an undisclosed sum.

cards.title: Meta Launches Open-Weight Model for Apple Macs
cards.body: Meta and Apple partnered to release Muse Spark Open, running locally on Apple silicon hardware. The open-weight model eliminates reliance on cloud computing for inference.

cards.title: Amazon Devices Chief Imagines App-Free AI Future
cards.body: Panos Panay, Amazon's devices chief, described a future where ambient AI anticipates user needs without apps. AI devices would operate invisibly in the background.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants METR Independent Research Access
cards.body: Anthropic gave frontier AI research firm METR employee-level access to assess risks and practices independently. METR can publish findings without requiring Anthropic approval.

cards.title: Bluesky's Attie Platform Enables 'Social Vibe Coding'
cards.body: Bluesky expanded its experimental Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and interactive experiences. Users can now create content that taps directly into Bluesky's social network.

cards.title: AI Agents Coming to Rivian Electric Vehicles
cards.body: Rivian announced AI agent integration for its vehicles, with more details expected at December's event. The company plans to showcase AI autonomy advances then.

cards.title: Google Launches Universal Cart Shopping Tool
cards.body: Google rolled out Universal Cart across Search and Gemini app in the United States. The shopping tool streamlines product discovery and purchasing directly within Google properties.

cards.title: Amazon's Bee Launches Two Personal AI Devices
cards.body: Amazon-owned Bee released new AI wearables starting at $75, including an updated device and credit-card-sized recorder. The devices integrate with Alexa for summarization and task management.

cards.title: Figma Announces New AI Agent Framework Features
cards.body: Figma released new features defining how AI agents operate on its design platform. The company also opened its code layers feature to beta testers.

cards.title: Ricursive Intelligence Automates AI Chip Design
cards.body: Ricursive Intelligence is developing AI systems to design semiconductor chips and learn from each iteration. The startup aims to solve compute crises through accelerated chip design automation.

cards.title: Meta's New Terms Could Slash AI Licensing Costs
cards.body: Meta may use sweeping commercial terms of service to avoid millions in AI licensing fees. The move reflects ongoing tensions around AI model training and data usage rights.

cards.title: FTC Probes Anthropic and OpenAI After Trump's AI Comments
cards.body: The FTC is investigating Anthropic and OpenAI following Trump's dismissal of AI concerns as a hoax. The probe examines competitive practices in the rapidly evolving AI industry.

cards.title: YouTube Music Uses Generative AI for Artist Labeling
cards.body: YouTube Music is rolling out a new generative AI feature to label whether audio comes from singers or synthesized sources. The tool aims to help users identify AI-generated music.
